SELECT a.frst_nm, a.last_nm, COUNT(*) AS num_films FROM actr a JOIN flm_act fa ON a.actr_id = fa.ref1 GROUP BY a.actr_id, a.frst_nm, a.last_nm ORDER BY num_films DESC, a.frst_nm ASC, a.last_nm ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT a.frst_nm AS `名`, a.last_nm AS `姓`, COUNT(DISTINCT fa.ref2) AS `出演数`
FROM actr AS a
LEFT JOIN flm_act AS fa ON fa.ref1 = a.actr_id
GROUP BY a.actr_id, a.frst_nm, a.last_nm
ORDER BY `出演数` DESC, `名` ASC, `姓` ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT a.frst_nm, a.last_nm, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM actr a
JOIN flm_act fa ON fa.ref1 = a.actr_id
GROUP BY a.actr_id, a.frst_nm, a.last_nm
ORDER BY cnt DESC, a.frst_nm ASC, a.last_nm ASC
LIMIT 10
SELECT c.frst_nm, c.last_nm, SUM(p.amt) AS amount FROM cust c JOIN pymt p ON c.cust_id = p.ref1 GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.frst_nm, c.last_nm ORDER BY amount DESC, c.frst_nm ASC, c.last_nm ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT c.frst_nm, c.last_nm, COALESCE(SUM(p.amt), 0) AS amount
FROM cust c
LEFT JOIN pymt p ON c.cust_id = p.ref1
GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.frst_nm, c.last_nm
ORDER BY amount DESC, c.frst_nm ASC, c.last_nm ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT c.frst_nm, c.last_nm, COALESCE(SUM(p.amt), 0) AS total_amount
FROM cust c
LEFT JOIN card ca ON ca.ref1 = c.cust_id
LEFT JOIN pymt p ON p.ref1 = ca.card_id
GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.frst_nm, c.last_nm
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, c.frst_nm ASC, c.last_nm ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT c.cty
FROM cust cu
JOIN addr a ON cu.ref2 = a.addr_id
JOIN city c ON a.ref1 = c.cty_id
JOIN pymt p ON p.ref1 = cu.cust_id
GROUP BY cu.cust_id, c.cty
ORDER BY SUM(p.amt) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT c.cty
FROM cust cu

JOIN city c ON a.ref1 = c.cty_id
WHERE cu.cust_id = (
    SELECT ref1
    FROM pymt
    GROUP BY ref1
    ORDER BY SUM(amt) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT c.cty
FROM pymt p
JOIN card ON p.ref1 = card.card_id
